central_question: When complete graduated G3 construction terms are treated as units of the next uplift, does inherited CAPS7 remain sufficient for all admitted G4 operations, or can a legitimate G4 context operationally distinguish equal-CAPS7 G3 units because of hidden G2-unit tree/fiber organization?

first_exact_challenge_pair.meaning: The pair is already known to be distinct inside the hidden G3 fiber while identical at CAPS7. Phase 0 uses it only as a firewall/challenge witness, not as proof that G4 reads topology.
first_exact_challenge_pair.source: certified G3:R1 exact n=4 hidden-fiber witness

g4_unit_definition: Any complete finite connected graduated G3 construction term, treated atomically at its earned G3 public interface. Exact hidden G2-unit tree/fiber organization is retained only as challenge evidence until a registered G4 context earns an added read.

initial_public_observer.rule: G4 Phase 0 inherits only graduated G3 CAPS7. Do not expose tree topology, shell profiles, degree data, graph distance, construction identity, owner witnesses, ancestry, branch identity, or provenance as public G4 state.

maturation_context.g3_r1_hidden_law: TREE_GRAFT_RELATION: connect one vertex of coarse tree T to one vertex of coarse tree U by one frozen G3 cross edge; for one-unit growth this is all leaf attachments T -> {T+leaf@v}
maturation_context.g3_r1_public_shadow: C_ab(f,g)=f+g-e_a-e_b is independent of attachment vertex and therefore collapses the topology-grafting relation
maturation_context.rule: R1/R2 evidence motivates the G4 challenge hierarchy only. It does not add a G3 public field.

outcome_partition_for_future_S1.REVIEW_REQUIRED: A distinction appears but cannot be attributed cleanly to an allowed public structural read without hidden provenance or post-hoc observer changes.
outcome_partition_for_future_S1.STRUCTURE_NOT_READ: Every admitted frozen S1 context factors through CAPS7 for the challenge domain.
outcome_partition_for_future_S1.STRUCTURE_READ_EARNED: At least one preregistered G4 context separates equal-CAPS7 G3 units. Proceed to the frozen tier ladder; do not jump directly to full topology.

stage_ladder.question: Freeze complete G3 units, extract inherited CAPS7, verify certified hidden-tree challenge authority, and expose no hidden descriptor.
Apply preregistered whole-G3-unit contexts to equal-CAPS7 challenge units and test whether any hidden structural distinction is operationally read without directly observing topology.

If S1 separates, identify the lowest preregistered relabel-invariant challenge-read tier sufficient for the frozen pair observer; otherwise certify the stronger CAPS7 pair quotient on the tested domain.
Test higher-order compatibility/irreducibility after the S2 quotient.
Test composition closure of the resulting G4 candidate units.
Earn a finite G4 read/write descriptor if one exists.
Test recursive closure and graduation; only this gate may authorize G4 graduation and R0.
